d:
Sardi mein bina pyaaz ke kurkure Palak Aloo Pakoda Sirf 10 minute mein, bazaar se bhi behtar!
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani par aaj Palak Aloo Pakoda: baarik palak, chhote aloo ke tukde aur kuta masala. Saath mein amchur ki chutney, bina imli bhigaye.
Bina pyaaz ke Palak Aloo Pakoda, ek dum kurkure
Amchur ki chutney, bina imli
Half fry + double fry: pakode oily nahi bante
Comment mein batayein: chai ya chutney ke saath?
